notes: Adds optional Tailcat Android AAR support, direct-host and tunnel racing, pinned TLS and bearer authentication on every route, winner-owned browser transport, guarded host refresh, retained-session recovery backoff, and sanitized diagnostics preview/export. Unit tests cover route selection, cancellation, late native cleanup, pin rejection before authentication, and existing reconnect/principal invariants. Earlier workspace, note, conversation, task, comment, attachment, Git, terminal, and browser features remain. Android is unreleased. Native tunnel traffic, diagnostics sharing, and browser previews still need device/live-daemon verification. Full VT rendering, note editing, video import, model selection, full rich rendering, and remaining iOS features are under development.
